name: v1.40.0 - Alter Schema Drop Vector Index, HFresh MUVERA, RQ-4 quantization
body:
## Breaking Changes

*none*

## Namespaces (GA)
*Namespaces add control-plane and data isolation between users on a shared cluster.*

* Namespaces: Gate tenant actions by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12513
* Namespaces: Add plumbing for namespace exister by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12541
* Pin replacement replicas to a namespace's home node by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12554
* Namespaces: Effective-suspended derivation + shard-materialization guards by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12464
* Namespaces: Add support for knowing which shards should be (un)loaded on suspend/resume by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13123
* Namespaces: Fix issues around references by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13304
* Make namespaces a feature requiring license by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13298

## Alter Schema - Drop vector index (GA)
*Support for dropping inverted indices from existing properties, allowing users to reclaim disk space by removing indices that are no longer needed, with RBAC integration and multi-tenancy support.*

* feat(drop-vector-index): resume interrupted strips from the recorded pending set by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12442
* test(drop-vector-index): retry the write after a leader kill instead of failing on the rejoin blip by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12678
* fix(drop-vector-index): remove the muvera bucket of a dropped multi-vector index by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12718
* fix(drop-vector-index): remove hfresh directory and buckets when the index is dropped by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12720
* fix(drop-vector-index): clear the dynamic upgrade verdict on the cold-tenant path by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12754
* ci(drop-vector-index): split the cluster and async-indexing jobs in two by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12773
* ci(drop-vector-index): always run drop vector index e2e tests by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12910
* fix(drop-vector-index): clear the dropped vector's dimension rows by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12918
* feat(drop-vector-index): enable the drop vector index endpoint by default by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13071

## Alter Schema - Reindex property (Preview)
*Adds support for changing property's index types.*

* chore(reindex): remove unreachable reindex and shard symbols by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12708
* chore: remove the /debug/index/rebuild/inverted* routes and the machinery only they could reach by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12706
* Delete the unreachable reindex restart-recovery path (OnBeforeLsmInit) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12704
* Refuse property names that collide with migration directories by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12873
* fix(reindex): only checkpoint reindex progress once the data is durable by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12877
* fix(reindex): RAFT-numbered directories stop a restart reporting success on an unbuilt index by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12888
* reindex: durable migration record (part 1/2, inert) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12847
* feat: node-level query admission control (P1b) by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12078
* fix(reindex): enable-rangeable becomes a semantic migration by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12700
* fix(reindex): index writes that land in a semantic migration's swap window by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13001

## HFresh
*Extensive improvements including numerous performance optimizations reducing memory usage, disk writes, and allocations.*

* perf(hfresh): parallelize rescoring with budget-aware workers by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12487
* perf(hfresh): read rescore vectors through one bucket view with pooled buffers by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12490
* perf(hfresh): warm the version map in the background at startup by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12504
* fix(hfresh): hold the posting lock during version map warmup by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12612
* fix(hfresh): decode centroid codes with the right quantizer in split/merge reassignment by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12795
* feat(hfresh): debug endpoint to reassign all vectors in place by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12820
* feat(hfresh): cluster posting splits on full-precision vectors by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12863
* perf(hfresh): fetch split vectors through a single bucket view by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12875
* fix(hfresh): resolve buckets per operation instead of caching them by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12887
* config: remove the dead HFreshEnabled flag by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12907
* feat(debug): make shard optional for HFresh reassignment by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13043
* fix(hfresh): filtered search results depended on posting probe order by @abdelr in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13121
* hfresh: count postings and shared buckets in the usage report by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13214
* debug: allow the debug vector rebuild on HFresh by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13257

## HFresh MUVERA

* HFresh MUVERA: Decouple Routing and Rerank Budgets by @abdelr in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/11785

## Deduplicated Backups

* Add opt-in dedupeReplicas backups: archive converged shards once, fan restore out to every replica by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12815
* backup: dedupe unloaded shards from their persisted hashtree root by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13105
* Gate deduplicated backups on a Weaviate license key by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13359

## Search REST API
*Adds dedicated REST API for performing search queries.*

* feat(rest): hybrid search endpoint (REST Search API 2/4) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12246
* feat(rest): near-object search endpoint (REST Search API 3/4) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12248
* feat(rest): aggregate counts endpoint (REST Search API 4/4) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12249
* feat(rest): structured reference selection (returnReferences) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12424
* feat(rest): drop the experimental search flag, harden the family for default-on by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13067
* backport: drop the experimental search flag, harden the family for default-on (#13067) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13233
* rest search: add the near-vector endpoint by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13265

## RQ4
*4Bit Rotational Quantization.*

* RQ4 centered quantization by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12502

## Async replication
*Async replication optimizations and fixes.*

* async replication: resolve replicas locally, never implicitly activate a tenant by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12256
* test(replication): wait for shard readiness after restart across read_repair suite by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12466
* perf(async-repl): size hashbeat digest buffers by set count, not leaf count by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12481
* perf(async-repl): carry byte-ID digests end-to-end on the compare pipeline by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12710
* perf(async-replication): gate hashbeat debug logging behind level check by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12760
* perf(async-replication): size prefilter chunk map by input, release dispatch buckets every pass by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12759
* perf(async-replication): batch root pre-filter across classes per target node by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12765
* perf(asyncrep): prune the scheduler due-count scan via the heap invariant by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12929
* perf(asyncrep): reuse per-worker request assembly in root-prefilter clients by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12939
* async replication: arm the hashtree init write gate at scan start by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13191
* async replication: retry a panicking hashtree init attempt and gate hashbeat on readiness by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13202
* hashtree: never trust a persisted snapshot with no object store behind it by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13164
* async replication: drain on a reuse-safe latch instead of a shared WaitGroup by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13201

## Replica movement hardening & semi-automated namespace cluster rebalancing

* refactor(replication): pin shards through writableShard and introduce replicaPreparer interface by @moogacs in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12427
* feat(rplc-mvmnt): add automated cleanup of stale replica movement operations by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12426
* perf(replication): cap zstd encoder concurrency and window in shared encoders by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12761
* feat(repl): fix concurrent map write race in replicated writes by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12730
* Commit replicated puts on object copies to unrace the broadcast marshal by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12828
* Fix replica movement to be enable-able via runtime config by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13064

## Backup reliability improvements

* Backups: never store a partially written chunk by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12463
* feat(backups): introduce `includeRoles` to backup/restore process by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12322
* Backup-gcs: add opt-in gRPC transport by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12447
* fix(backup): serve a failed backup's reason from the participant status by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12548
* Include GEO HNSW index in backups by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12584
* Backup index.db from inactive dynamic tenants by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12724
* fix(restore): route backup restore of RBAC roles and dynamic users through RAFT by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12660
* Back up collections concurrently through one shared worker pool by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12790
* backup-gcs: default to the gRPC transport by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12824
* fix(backup): missed include wildcards are a no-op for users/roles, an error for classes by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13027
* gh-12658 exclude LSM scratch files from the offload-s3 shard upload by @bharadwaj-pendyala in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12884
* Remove fsync from CopyFile, which only writes backup copies by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13079
* backup: report logical PreCompressionSizeBytes for replica-deduped backups by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13090
* backup: publish CANCELED only after the cancel descriptor is durable by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13098
* fix(backup): poll participant status with exponential backoff during commit by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13266
* Stop backup endpoints from exposing collections the caller cannot access by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13274
* Add a read_backups permission action by @spiros-spiros in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13433

## Modules & Integrations

* fix(modules): skip vectorizing named vectors whose index is mid-drop by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12498
* fix(modules): don't panic when a batch has objects with no vectorizable properties by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12617
* feat(generative-digitalocean): add DigitalOcean generative module by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12786
* feat(generative-meta): add Meta AI generative module by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12839
* test(generative-aws): remove Cohere's Command-R models from tests by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12841
* modules(rest): remove /v1/modules endpoint and contextionary extension/concept handlers by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13083
* refactor(config): retire DEFAULT_VECTORIZER_MODULE, default legacy vectorizer to none by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13232
* fix(multi2vec-google): route gemini-embedding-2 on Vertex AI to global :embedContent by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13340
* fix(generative-digitalocean): add env var support and model list validation by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13392
* fix(modules): read a fractional json.Number in float module settings by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13403
* test(generative-aws): update Anthropic test models by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13348
* Let modules decide which settings can change on an existing collection by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13346

## Usage metrics improvements

* test(usage): wait for storage to settle instead of relaxing the assertions by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12635
* fix(usage): skip dropped named vectors when computing cold shard usage by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12681
* fix(usage): report legacy vector alongside named vectors in usage metrics by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12682
* Add MUVERA specific usage calculations by @trengrj in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12294
* Align returns for HOT and COLD tenants from usage module by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12712
* test(usage): settle the reactivated shard before taking the drop-vector baseline by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12721
* Skip vanished files and directories instead of failing shard usage by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12832
* Fix shard loaded and unloaded metrics by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12827
* Cache object count for lazy shards by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12835
* Add weaviate_shards, a shard count by state and eager or lazy loading by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12831

## Vector Index Schema Update

* chore: bake vector index identity into its logger by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12919
* chore: extend vector index logger identity to hnsw's children and the queue by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12922
* chore: pin the on-disk vector index layout by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12923
* flat: derive flat index storage names from the physical ID by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12924
* dynamic: Derive dynamic index storage names and state key from the physical ID by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12925
* hnsw: derive hnsw compressed bucket names from the physical ID by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12932
* hfresh: derive hfresh index storage names and centroid ID from the physical ID by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12928
* hnsw: hnsw takes object-vector extraction from the shard and never prefills a centroid graph from objects by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12933
* shard: vector indexes and queues live in one slots type by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12965
* shard: request paths hold a lease on the vector index by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12970
* shard: maintenance and debug paths hold a lease on the vector index by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12975
* shard: the unleased vector index accessors go by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12976
* shardmeta: add Namespace.Update and ForEach by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12993
* shard: add the vectorIndexMapping type by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12994
* shard: open index.db for every shard, add the vector index storage probe and sync by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12998
* shard: startup reads and writes the vector index mapping by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13015
* shard: rebuild a ready index whose storage is missing instead of refusing the load by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13087
* shard: a vector added to a running shard is recorded, and a colliding one refused by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13030
* queue: release the chunk writer buffer once a chunk is promoted by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13126
* shard: a replica snapshot carries index.db by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13128
* shard: a replica snapshot carries index.db, so a moved dynamic index keeps its upgrade (v1.38) by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13130
* shard mapping: durable vector index deletion through the mapping record by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13116
* shard: refuse a write whose vector index is missing before storing the object by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13305
* shard: the drop sweep reaches a cold tenant through its lazy loader by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13316
* shard: fix vectorQueueSize and cold shard loading on the shards status endpoint by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13349

## Performance & Optimization

* Refresh the memory monitor while shards are read-only by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12468
* Use direct map acces for shard movement teardown by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12467
* Remove the unused shardReindexerV3 scheduler by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12478
* Pool zstd encoders in backups by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12477
* lsmkv: stop CheckExpectedStrategy from heap-allocating its variadic slice by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12494
* Read the dimensions bucket once per usage sweep by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12503
* Report the tenant's pre-freeze status on an aborted freeze by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12508
* Unmarshal namespace snapshot outside of lock by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12506
* Size the roaringsetrange pread read buffer from the segment payload by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12499
* Keep the geo vector cache across deletion cycles by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12557
* Keep error type through the objects manager by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12510
* Read only the geo property when resolving a coordinate by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12564
* shard: don't mark the shard read-only during UpdateVectorIndexConfig by @amourao in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/11788
* perf(lsmkv): targeted replace scan with newest-wins visibility by @amourao in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12396
* Keep the parked pread buffer on sequential replace cursor scans by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12571
* Complete updateIndexTenants when one tenant fails by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12507
* Drop per-cycle allocations from the idle compaction path by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12561
* perf(lsmkv): read targeted-scan ranges straight from the file by @amourao in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12592
* Parse replace nodes without allocating by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12558
* Treat a non-positive vector cache maxSize as unbounded by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12586
* Concurrently prefill geo caches using exinsg prefiller by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12583
* feat(rest): bm25 keyword search endpoint (REST Search API 1/4) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12245
* Hybrid Aggregation: Apply the filter to the BM25 search by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12622
* Wait for the local schema before writes that resolve an index by name by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12587
* feat(auto-schema): create a "default" named vector instead of a legacy one by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12620
* Report every shard failure during index reconcile by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12639
* Usage: Make cold tenants report the same data as hot tenants by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12628
* perf(lsmkv): bound digest-RPC memtable snapshots to the requested key range by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12665
* perf(async-repl): negotiate binary digest encoding on the gRPC HashTreeLevel RPC by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12666
* Resource scan: Dont load lazy shards and set newly loaded shards to ReadOnly too by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12674
* perf(router): avoid full shard-list copy on single-shard routing plans by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12762
* Make the resource scanner's shard status check-and-set atomic by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12703
* Put both cron jobs on one shared registration helper by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12758
* Backport: drain in-flight references before drop tears the shard store down by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12797
* Stop retrying a shard unload once its collection is closing by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12779
* feat(users): export/import endpoints for db user API-key hashes by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12782
* Silence expected recovered-panic noise in async replication scheduler unit tests by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12808
* Remove find-duplicates workflow when new issues are created. by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12801
* mcp: refuse GET with 405 and run the streamable server stateless by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12789
* Stop holding the collection map lock while counting objects on disk by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12825
* Finish the startup shard warmup after a shard fails to load by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12837
* Disable background lazy tenant loading for small tenants by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12834
* Run every row of the object authorization tables by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12840
* perf(inverted): cut batched Contains extraction allocations and faster segment-index reads by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12436
* lsmkv, inverted: read a batch of roaring set rows through one batch reader by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12530
* Shut down test indexes so background flush cannot race TempDir cleanup by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12858
* inverted: hold the batched Contains keys as a sorted slab by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12614
* lsmkv: read the batched Contains keys from a memtable a window at a time by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12701
* Move index.db ownership from the dynamic index to the shard by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12881
* perf(lsmkv): read and seek segment indexes without materializing keys by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12856
* hnsw: lock each neighbor before reading its connections in ACORN search by @jfrancoa in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12936
